Every autumn, the fields of Pampore in Kashmir, burst into vibrant purple as Saffron Crocus blooms cover the valley, filling the air with a subtle, earthy aroma. Skilled hands gently pluck the crimson stigmas from each flower, gathering the world’s most precious spice. Known for its rich colour, flavour, and medicinal benefits, Kashmiri Saffron is celebrated globally, carrying the legacy of this ancient land.
We are here too!
